0.0: Wait, wait, wait, I know this word! Orbis! #t4031056# must be hidden inside Orbis Tower! Yes, it's all coming back. The map says the book is hidden in the #bstatue in Orbis Tower <8th Floor>#k. Who would have guessed?
0.1: To open that statue, you will need the #b#t4031053##k. The ring must be the key! Hurry now, go to the 8th floor of Orbis Tower. And don't forget to bring me the #b#t4031056##k! I'll try to find a way to seal the #b#t4031056##k while you're gone. Tell me when you're ready, and I'll shoot you off to the Entrance to Orbis Tower.\r\n\r\n(Accept to go to the Entrance to Orbis Tower.)

no.0: It's almost done! Are you sure you want to give up now?

1.0: At the bottom of the statue lies a sparkling core. Use #b#t4031053##k to unlock it and investigate what's inside.
